apps.name: Tsumi
apps.subtitle: Watch anime and shows, alone or with friends.
apps.localizedDescription:
Tsumi is a native iPhone and iPad app to watch anime and shows from the sources you add (extensions).

- Browse, search and follow the airing schedule
- Sync your list and progress with AniList or MyAnimeList
- Watch Together: shared playback with friends
- Discord rich presence

The IPA is unsigned: Feather, AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly signs it on install.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Watch Together connects directly to the other people in your lobby, including devices on the same network.
